issues.where: the red water surface in the mid-frame, under the dome and toward the right
issues.what: the fine ripple streaks and small bright foam flecks are slightly smeared and softer than before compression. The water still reads as rippled water, and I see no banding or blocks.
issues.fix: give the water a little more bitrate or keep a touch more grain there so the ripples keep their crispness

issues.where: the glassy dome's patchy highlights and the pale sky around the palm crowns
issues.what: the soft gradients are slightly smoothed and the thin palm fronds lose a little edge definition. There are no visible steps in the sky and the fronds still read as fronds.
issues.fix: keep the sky gradient dithered or grained so it stays smooth, and keep a little more bitrate around the thin fronds

issues.where: the smooth pink sand-bar and silt area in front of the foreground rocks
issues.what: the large soft area is a little flatter after compression, with a faint loss of tonal texture. No contour steps appear, so this shows only in the side-by-side crops.
issues.fix: add light grain or dither to the smooth gradient so it holds its tonal variation
